long_biography.plain_text:
John S. Latsis built the family enterprise from passenger ferries and merchant shipping into tankers, oil refining and banking. Marianna Latsis inherited a share alongside her siblings. The 2019 division left her with the privately owned Latsco shipping business while other branches retained banking and property arms.

Latsis now directs her interests through Latsco Family Office, which invests for her family in Greece and abroad. Its portfolio extends from shipping and energy into infrastructure, construction, real estate and technology. Recent transactions include stakes in GEK Terna, Trade Estates and the Attiki Odos concession. The 2025 Attiki Odos stake sits in Latsco Direct Investments Cyprus, a vehicle representing her interests.
